title: General Availability - Domainless SAML IdP federation for workforce tenants
description: Domainless SAML federation with a SAML Identity Provider allows external users to authenticate into your apps or workforce resources using their IdP-managed credentials, regardless of their email domain. Domainless federation removes the need for domain matching between the user's email and preconfigured IdP domains during sign-in or invitation redemption.
